[event:evt.gen_43.brothers_set_out] Travel: Hebron to Egypt by donkey is about 493 km, 15 days. The text states no duration. Jacob's household is at Hebron (Gen 37:14), so I used that. Memphis or On would be somewhat nearer than the registry's Egypt point, which I did not adjust.

[event:evt.gen_43.joseph_receives_brothers] Joseph's noon dinner is on the day of arrival: the brothers reach Joseph in the morning (v. 16 'at noon' refers to the dinner time, Rashi/Radak read it as the main meal). I set the departure at dawn and counted 15 full days so the arrival falls at 06:00 and the noon meal is the same day.

[event:evt.gen_43.israel_consents] v. 14 is a wish, not a prophecy: 'may El Shaddai give you mercy... that he release Simeon and Benjamin'. It is partly fulfilled at 43:23 (Simeon freed) and in ch. 44-45; I wrote no FULFILLS_PROPHECY link. Chapter 44-45 sessions may link it.
[entity:person.steward_of_joseph] Unnamed official, identified only by the phrase 'the one over his house'. 'The man' in 43:17-25 is taken to be the same steward throughout; no TIPNR id.
[entity:loc.house_of_joseph] Defined as a place without coordinates; the text does not say which Egyptian city. No geo values invented.
[event_links:evt.gen_43.brothers_set_out] No place given: the journey runs from Canaan to Egypt, so the event has no location.
[event_links:evt.gen_43.brothers_stand_before_joseph] Located at loc.egypt only, because the text does not say where Joseph saw them before bringing them to his house.
[component:comp.simeon.custody.2] Inferred: the text says only that he was brought out; RELEASED is my reading. comp.simeon.custody.1 is closed by a closure entry and superseded.
[component:comp.israel.protectiveness.2] Inferred state: Israel yields Benjamin at 43:13, though 43:14 still shows grief ('if I am bereaved'). Closes FEARS_FOR_BENJAMIN from GEN.42.
